The '''''One Two Many''''' was a [[Bulk cruiser/Legends|bulk cruiser]] owned and operated by a crew of [[Corellian/Legends|Corellians]] during the [[Imperial Era/Legends|Imperial era]]. Among its crew were [[Janzel Helot]], [[Shandy Fanaso]], and [[Devoris]].
